Melodic dictation

Name Date

Listen to a four-measure melody three times and notate it. The key signature and meter are given, and so is the pitch of the first note; you notate its rhythm too. A count-off sets the tempo before each hearing.

Melody

Shorter notes leave a little silence before the next one, so the rhythm is easier to hear.

Cello and flute recordings: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios, Musical Instrument Samples.
